source.sqlReaderQuery:
;WITH run1 AS
(
SELECT	CASE	CASE WHEN RASTATUS = 'H' THEN h.RETLOC ELSE h.OUTLOC END 
				WHEN 'DUB' THEN '200'
				WHEN 'COR' THEN '300'
				WHEN 'LIM' THEN '400'
				WHEN 'WEX' THEN '500'
				ELSE LEFT(l.BUSSOURCE,2) END AS [location_id],
		CASE WHEN h.OFFSITEDATE BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN h.OFFSITEDATE
			 WHEN h.ONSITEDATE BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN h.ONSITEDATE 
			 WHEN (h.OFFSITEDATE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND h.ONSITEDATE > DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND h.RASTATUS = 'H') THEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) 
			 WHEN h.ONSITEDATE < DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND h.RASTATUS = 'H' THEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) END AS [date],

		CASE WHEN (h.OFFSITEDATE BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND h.RASTATUS IN ('A','B')) THEN 'due out' 
			 ELSE 'to collect' END AS [action],
		h.RANO AS [rental_agreement],
		CASE WHEN a.CAT = 'C' THEN 'C' ELSE 'A' END AS [customer_type],
		h.RASTATUS AS [rental_status],
		hg.HIREGPDESC AS [vehicle_description],
		h.REGNO AS [registration],
		CASE WHEN h.RASTATUS = 'h' THEN DATEDIFF(DAY,h.OFFSITEDATE,GETDATE()) ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY,h.OUTDATE,h.RETDATE) END AS [days_on_hire],
		h.NONBILTB AS [instructions],
		'?' AS [vehicle_ready],
		CAST(h.OFFSITEDATE AS date) AS [out_date],
		h.OFFSITETIME AS [out_time],
		CAST(h.ONSITEDATE AS date) AS [return_date],
		h.ONSITETIME AS [return_time],
		h.INVNAME AS [customer],
		'' AS [delivery_collection_type],
		'' AS [delivery_collection],
		'' AS [postcode],
		'' AS [address1],
		'' AS [address2],
		'' AS [address3],
		'' AS [address4],
		'' AS [address5],
		CASE WHEN RASTATUS = 'H' THEN h.RETLOC ELSE h.OUTLOC END AS [sub_location_id],
		CONCAT(RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(COMMENTS1))),RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(COMMENTS2))),RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(COMMENTS3))),RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(COMMENTS4))),RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(COMMENTS5)))) AS [comments]
FROM Whiteboard_Data h
LEFT JOIN
LookupHireGroups hg ON hg.HIREGROUP = h.HIREGROUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AS
LEFT JOIN
LookupLocat l ON l.LOC = h.OUTLOC
LEFT JOIN
SLaccounts a ON a.ACCOUNT = h.ACCOUNT

WHERE
(
(CAST(h.OFFSITEDATE AS date) BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND DATEADD(DAY,27,CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND (h.RASTATUS = 'A' OR h.RASTATUS = 'B'))
OR 
(h.RASTATUS = 'h')
)
),
run2 AS
(
SELECT	CASE WHEN [action] = 'to collect' THEN 
												CASE sub_location_id WHEN 'DUB' THEN 200 
																	 WHEN 'COR' THEN 300
																	 WHEN 'LIM' THEN 400
																	 WHEN 'WEX' THEN 500
																	 ELSE
																	 CONVERT(varchar(20),LEFT(l2.BUSSOURCE,2)) 
												END 
										  ELSE 
												CASE sub_location_id WHEN 'DUB' THEN 200 
																	 WHEN 'COR' THEN 300
																	 WHEN 'LIM' THEN 400
																	 WHEN 'WEX' THEN 500
																	 ELSE
																	 CONVERT(varchar(20),LEFT(l1.BUSSOURCE,2))  
												END
		END AS [location_id],
		CONVERT(varchar(10),FORMAT([date],'dd/MM/yyyy')) AS [date],
		CAST(RTRIM(action) AS varchar(10)) AS [action],
		CAST(RTRIM(rental_agreement) AS varchar(10)) AS [rental_agreement],
		CAST(RTRIM(CASE WHEN (customer_type = 'C' AND h.TARIFFCODE = 'W') THEN 'W' 
			 WHEN (customer_type = 'C' AND h.TARIFFCODE = 'RE') THEN 'RE' 
			 WHEN (customer_type = 'C' AND h.TARIFFCODE = 'SP') THEN 'SP'
			 WHEN (customer_type = 'C' AND h.TARIFFCODE = 'NR') THEN 'NR'  
			 WHEN (customer_type = 'C' AND h.TARIFFCODE = 'DL') THEN 'DL'
			 ELSE customer_type END) AS varchar(10)) AS [customer_type],
		CAST(RTRIM(rental_status) AS varchar(10)) AS [rental_status],
		CAST(RTRIM(vehicle_description) AS varchar(100)) AS [vehicle_description],
		CAST(RTRIM(registration) AS varchar(10)) AS [registration],
		CAST(RTRIM(CASE WHEN rental_status = 'H' THEN DATEDIFF(DAY,return_date,GETDATE()) ELSE days_on_hire END) AS varchar(10)) AS [days_on_hire],
		CAST(RTRIM(instructions) AS varchar(200)) AS [instructions],
		CAST(RTRIM(CASE WHEN h.CONTRACT IN ('A','B','C','D','F','R','I','H') THEN LOWER(h.CONTRACT) ELSE '' END) AS varchar(10)) AS [vehicle_ready],
		CASE WHEN [action] = 'to collect' THEN '0' ELSE CONVERT(varchar(10),FORMAT(out_date,'dd/MM/yyyy')) END AS [out_date],
		CAST(RTRIM(out_time) AS varchar(10)) AS [out_time],
		CASE WHEN [action] = 'due out' THEN '0' ELSE CONVERT(varchar(10),FORMAT(return_date,'dd/MM/yyyy')) END AS [return_date],
		CAST(RTRIM(return_time) AS varchar(10)) AS [return_time],
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(customer,',','')) AS varchar(100)) AS [customer],
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELTYPE ELSE h.COLTYPE END,',','')) AS varchar(10)) AS delivery_collection_type,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELIVER ELSE h.COLLECT END,',','')) AS varchar(10)) AS delivery_collection,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELPOSTCODE ELSE COLPOSTCODE END,',','')) AS varchar(10)) AS postcode,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELADD1 ELSE COLADD1 END,',','')) AS varchar(50)) AS address1,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELADD2 ELSE COLADD2 END,',','')) AS varchar(50)) AS address2,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELADD3 ELSE COLADD3 END,',','')) AS varchar(50)) AS address3,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELADD4 ELSE COLADD4 END,',','')) AS varchar(50)) AS address4,
		CAST(RTRIM(REPLACE(CASE WHEN action = 'due out' THEN h.DELADD5 ELSE COLADD5 END,',','')) AS varchar(50)) AS address5,
		CAST(RTRIM(sub_location_id) AS varchar(20)) AS [sub_location_id],
		CAST([comments] AS varchar(300)) AS [comments]
FROM run1
JOIN Whiteboard_Data h ON h.RANO = run1.rental_agreement AND CASE WHEN rental_status = 'H' THEN h.RETLOC ELSE h.OUTLOC END = sub_location_id
LEFT JOIN LookupLocat l1 ON l1.LOC = h.OUTLOC
LEFT JOIN LookupLocat l2 ON l2.LOC = h.RETLOC),

run3 AS (
SELECT 	TOP 10000 location_id,
		[date],
		[action],
		rental_agreement,
		customer_type,
		rental_status,
		vehicle_description,
		registration,
		days_on_hire,
		instructions,
		vehicle_ready,
		out_date,
		out_time,
		return_date,
		return_time,
		customer,
		delivery_collection_type,
		delivery_collection,
		run2.postcode,
		run2.address1,
		run2.address2,
		run2.address3,
		run2.address4,
		run2.address5,
		sub_location_id,
		comments
FROM run2
JOIN Whiteboard_Data h ON h.RANO = run2.rental_agreement
WHERE [date] IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY [action],
		 CASE WHEN [action] = 'due out' THEN
					CASE WHEN LEN(out_time) = 4 THEN CONCAT('0',out_time) ELSE out_time END
					ELSE
					CASE WHEN LEN(return_time) = 4 THEN CONCAT('0',return_time) ELSE return_time END
		 END,
			CASE WHEN [action] = 'to collect' THEN days_on_hire END)

SELECT DISTINCT rental_agreement RANO,
				sub_location_id LOC
FROM run3
WHERE sub_location_id != 'ROM'
AND location_id IS NULL
